UPHESC Assistant Professor 2022 Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Higher Education Service Commission (UPHESC) has released result for selection to the posts of Assistant Professor under the Advt No. : 51-2022. The vacancy came in the year 2022 and it took almost four years to conduct the written examination for the prescribed posts. The written examination was held on 18-19 April 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPHESC Assistant Professor Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 09 July 2022
  • Application Start Date : 09 July 2022
  • Last Date : 29 August 2022
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 August 2022
  • Correction Last Date : 31 August 2022
  • Exam Date : 16-17 April 2025
  • Admit Card : 07 April 2025
  • Answer Key : 10 May 2025
  • Result/ Cutoff : 04 September 2025
  • New Exam Date : 18-19 April 2026
  • Exam City Details : 08 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 15 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 22 April 2026
  • Result : 10 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 1000/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
